AccessComponent.description: One part of an access walk's cost.

sources.description: Evidence types, sorted and unique, such as `osm` or `gtfs_pathway`.

AccessReport.description: How a place attached to the street network, reported when access fails.

Accessibility.description: The wheelchair profile a Result was computed under.

oneOf.description: Nondominated arrival, boarding and walking trade-offs.
The earliest distinct vehicle sequences, dominated ones included.

AlternativeSearch.description: How alternatives were found: requested alternatives, or a journey window.

coverage.description: `requested_time` for requested alternatives, `sampled` for a window.

Bounds.description: `[west, south, east, north]` in WGS84 degrees.

Capabilities.description: Check these before relying on an optional feature.

Clock.description:
A service-day clock: `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS` (hours may exceed 23), or minutes
after the start of the service day.

residency.description: Resident scenarios and shared timetable accounting. Diagnostic.

faster.description: Omitted when comparing internal trace results.

CompareRequest.description: `POST /v1/compare`: two saved Results of the same query family.

after.description: A Result of the same family as `before`.

before.description:
A saved `vigo.route.v1`, `vigo.matrix.v1` or `vigo.reach.v1` Result.
Internal trace results are also accepted, without stability guarantees.

CompareResult.description: Changes between two saved Results, after minus before, in seconds.

counts.description: Matrix and Reach: cell and pair counts.

meanChangeSeconds.description: Matrix and Reach: mean over mutually reachable entries; `null` when none.

CutoffFeatures.description: A GeoJSON `FeatureCollection` of cutoff areas or contours.

DatasetLimitation.description: A dataset or model limitation of the City.

Endpoint.description: A place on a journey. A free coordinate has no `stop` or `name`.

EndpointConnector.description: The straight hop between a free coordinate and its street attachment.

Enumerated.description: A GTFS-Realtime enumeration, by name or by numeric code.

ErrorDetail.description: Handle `code` and the HTTP status, not message text.

Fare.description: The published fare for a ride, or why there is none.

media.description: Fare media name; empty when unspecified.

riderCategory.description: Fares v2 only; empty when unspecified.

Identifier.description:
A feed-scoped GTFS identifier, such as a stop, route, trip or service.
`feed` is `null` in a City built from a single unscoped feed.

InfoResult.description: A loaded City: identity, sources, size and limits.

memory.description: Process memory accounting. Diagnostic; its fields may change.

Journey.description:
One way to make the trip. Clocks are service-day `HH:MM:SS` (hours may
exceed 23); durations are integer seconds.

clockDate.description:
Date anchoring every clock in this journey. Route only; `null` for a
walking or driving journey without a service date.

waitingSeconds.description: Gaps before and between legs. Not a reliability margin.

oneOf.description:
The exact timed trip, stop and boarding witness, without display
metadata or walking evidence.

MatrixAccess.description: Matrix access reports, keyed by endpoint index.

MatrixRequest.description: `POST /v1/matrix`: travel times between every origin and destination.

diagnostics.description:
Added detail: `summary` counters, `profile` timings, or the
unstable internal `trace`. Default `none`.

includeLimitations.description: Add the City's dataset limitations to the Result. Default `false`.

kind.description: Query kind on a resident stream.

scenarioId.description: Member of the loaded scenario collection; omitted selects its default.

walkSpeedKph.description: Default from the City. Walking Route and Matrix, and Reach.

wheelchair.description:
Require a City prepared with the wheelchair-strict-v1 profile.
Omitted inherits the City's profile; `false` rejects a wheelchair City.

Meta.description: How this Result was computed and how to reproduce it.

computeUs.description: Service-date activation, search and materialization, in microseconds.

queryFingerprint.description:
Hash of the request (stop references canonicalized, output switches
excluded) and the City revision.

requestId.description: The caller's `id` when given; otherwise generated.

Notice.description: A code for programs and a message for people.

ObservedTraffic.description:
Observed traffic. One of `observedAt`, `fetchedAt` or `timestamp` is
required, and one of `observations`, `segments` or `edgeUpdates`.

id.description: Caller's label for a Matrix endpoint, echoed in `query`.

stopId.description: Older form of `stop`: an ID, scoped as `feed` + U+001F + `id`.

Point.description:
A place: a bare `[longitude, latitude]`, or an object naming a stop and/or
coordinate. A selected stop overrides the coordinate unless `source` is
`map`.

Profile.description:
Measured timings, with `diagnostics: "profile"` or `"trace"`. Scopes can
overlap; do not add them.

timingsUs.description: Dotted scope names to integer microseconds.

source.description: The feed the fare came from.

QueryPlace.description: A requested place, in public form.

oneOf.description: A valid outcome: nothing satisfies the request.
Areas for the full reached extent, without rasters or stop lists.

ReachMode.description: Reach covers transit and walking only.

ReachRequest.description: `POST /v1/reach` (and `/v1/isochrone`): where an origin reaches within cutoffs.

diagnostics.description:
Added detail: `summary` counters, `profile` timings, or the
unstable internal `trace`. Default `none`.

includeLimitations.description: Add the City's dataset limitations to the Result. Default `false`.

kind.description: Query kind on a resident stream.

scenarioId.description: Member of the loaded scenario collection; omitted selects its default.

walkSpeedKph.description: Default from the City. Walking Route and Matrix, and Reach.

wheelchair.description:
Require a City prepared with the wheelchair-strict-v1 profile.
Omitted inherits the City's profile; `false` rejects a wheelchair City.

areas.description:
Areas within each cutoff. With `reachFormat: "map"`, these cover the
full reached extent.

fullSurface.description: The same grid over the complete reached extent.

ReachStop.description: A stop reached by Reach, and when.

ReachSurface.description: Reached time on a regular grid, row-major from the northwest corner.

ReachTimePreference.description: Reach searches forward in time only.

RealtimeReport.description: How a supplied realtime snapshot was admitted and applied.

RealtimeSnapshot.description:
Trip Updates applied to one Route request. Freshness is checked against
the current time.

Response.description: Any document the engine writes for a query, keyed by its `schema`.

RouteQuery.description: The request as the engine understood it. Endpoints echo the caller's places.

alternativeSlackMinutes.description: Latest admitted arrival, in minutes after the primary arrival. Default 15.

alternatives.description: Additional depart-at transit journeys; 0 turns alternatives off.

arrivalBufferMinutes.description: Arrival reserve for arrive-by transit without via points.

diagnostics.description:
Added detail: `summary` counters, `profile` timings, or the
unstable internal `trace`. Default `none`.

includeLimitations.description: Add the City's dataset limitations to the Result. Default `false`.

kind.description: Query kind on a resident stream.

requireTransitRide.description: Default `false`: a direct walk may answer the query.

scenarioId.description: Member of the loaded scenario collection; omitted selects its default.

walkSpeedKph.description: Default from the City. Walking Route and Matrix, and Reach.

wheelchair.description:
Require a City prepared with the wheelchair-strict-v1 profile.
Omitted inherits the City's profile; `false` rejects a wheelchair City.

windowMinutes.description: Sample later departures (or earlier deadlines) over this many minutes.

alternatives.description: Further distinct journeys; omitted when there are none.

sequence.description: Line number on a resident stream.

Scenario.description: A request-scoped service change. Use `services` or a compiled `overlay`.

overlay.description: A compiled native overlay; see the native field reference.

stops.description: At least two places, in service order.

oneOf.description: Modeled timetable times, not observed punctuality.
The source repeats times or bridges untimed stops.

SearchSummary.description:
Search counters, with `diagnostics: "summary"` or more. Counters without
instrumentation are omitted.

oneOf.description: Untimed stairs or gates priced by routing estimates.

StopInput.description: A stop reference. Omit `feed`, or send `null`, for an unscoped feed.

StreamDetail.description:
`stream --stream-output=detailed`: the internal result without a public
projection. `trace` is the unstable internal ABI.

StreetEdges.description:
Reached street intervals in indexed form. Every per-interval array has
`count` entries.

durationMinutes.description: Elapsed minutes at each interval end.

endpoints.description: From/to local node indices, `2 * count` long.

fromDurationMinutes.description: Elapsed minutes at each interval start.

transitArrivalMinutes.description: Elapsed minutes at the transit seed; −1 for the direct-origin seed.

components.description: Street and station costs and their sources, when station access applies.

geometrySource.description:
Where the line came from: `osm`, `osm_and_station_path`, `gtfs_pathway`,
`station_selection`, `unverified_transfer` or `unknown`. Treat other
values as unverified.

TimePreference.description: The time preference a Result reports, after aliases are resolved.

Timestamp.description: POSIX milliseconds, or an RFC 3339 date-time.

Traffic.description: Supplied traffic for driving: prepared edge times, or observations.

TrafficObservation.description: Directed geometry or edge indices, and exactly one cost effect.

TransitLeg.description: A ride on one scheduled trip.

distanceMeters.description: Length of the returned line, boarding to alighting stop.

geometry.description:
Where the line came from: `gtfs_shape` (aligned to the feed's shape),
`stop_sequence` (straight lines between stops) or `unknown`.

color.description: GTFS `route_color`, without `#`; empty when the feed gives none.

info.description: Route, Matrix, Reach and Compare over a prepared City. Generated from the vigo-model types. Bearer authentication is optional only on a loopback listener without a configured token.
